g.text: Residual audit: ĝ + I/π · (g − ĝ), with positive audit probability π, preserves the conditional raw-gradient mean.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546579

g.text: For content + time, use joint probes. Shared producer probes retain their cross terms. Versions and causal horizons must match.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546579

g.text: This panel explains continuous credit. Hard-route interventions use future-loss advantages; their acquisition and audits are additional work.
